errors.offline: You seem to be offline, so this didn't go through. Check your signal and try again. Nothing you entered is lost.
errors.slowServer: The server is taking longer than usual to respond. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Your account isn't allowed to do this. If you think it should be, ask your administrator or the farm owner.
errors.notFound: We couldn't find what you asked for. It may have been removed or moved. Go back and try again.
errors.conflict: This was changed by someone else a moment ago. Refresh the page to see the latest, then try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: You're doing that too quickly. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.serverTrouble: Something went wrong on our side, not yours. Please try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, contact support.
errors.generic: That didn't work. Please check what you entered and try again.
